preserved_constraints.statement: Repeat a tool in each step it belongs to (e.g. Ocean.io in Steps 1 and 2); do not deduplicate across steps.
preserved_constraints.asset_handling: One prepared asset reused for every occurrence of a repeated tool (e.g. HubSpot ×6).

preserved_constraints.statement: Do not invent tool or vendor names; signal categories and parallel dialing / gifting remain without vendors.
preserved_constraints.asset_handling: No logos invented; four product entities and Custom Scrapers use text labels; signal categories have no assets.

preserved_constraints.statement: Number exactly six steps; downstream items and closed-won are unnumbered.
Show only the path toward closed-won; no closed-lost branch.
No numerical scores or thresholds; no mapping between awareness stages and tiers.
Demand generation is one-to-one / one-to-many, not inbound/outbound; video outreach sits in one-to-many.
Use corrected orders: considering before selecting; sequence enrollment before CRM tasks; recap order for steps.
Use Claygent (not Clay) in Step 2, Claude Code (not Claude), and X (formerly Twitter).
preserved_constraints.asset_handling: X uses the current X mark; Claygent does not use the Clay mark; Claude Code does not use the Claude mark.

preserved_constraints.statement: HubSpot and Salesforce are either/or CRM options, not both required.
